name: obsidian-tasknotes
title: Obsidian TaskNotes
description: Bring TaskNotes task management to Raycast with natural language parsing. Create, view, and manage your Obsidian tasks using everyday language—no complex syntax required.
author: rodi01

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: API Port
preferences.description: Port for the TaskNotes API endpoint (default: 8080)

preferences.name: defaultLocale
preferences.title: Default Locale
preferences.description: Locale to use for new tasks (e.g. en, pt, es)

preferences.name: AuthToken
preferences.title: Auth Token
preferences.description: Optional bearer token to authenticate requests to the TaskNotes API

preferences.name: defaultStatus
preferences.title: Default Status
preferences.description: Default status to apply to quick-add tasks

preferences.name: defaultTags
preferences.title: Default Tags (Optional)
preferences.description: Default tags to add to tasks (comma-separated, e.g. personal, project)

preferences.name: defaultContexts
preferences.title: Default Contexts (Optional)
preferences.description: Default contexts to add to tasks (comma-separated, e.g. work, home)

commands.name: tasknotes-create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.description: Create a task on Obsidian using TaskNotes

commands.name: tasknotes-quick-add-task
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.description: Quickly add a task in Obsidian TaskNotes using natural language

arguments.name: task
arguments.placeholder: Buy groceries tomorrow at 3pm @home #errands high priority

commands.name: tasknotes-my-tasks
commands.title: My TaskNotes
commands.description: List and manage your TaskNotes tasks

commands.name: tasknotes-menu-bar
commands.title: TaskNotes Menu Bar
commands.description: Show your TaskNotes tasks in the menu bar for quick access

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
